title: Germany news: IG Metall calls for new 24-hour strike
summary: Germany's biggest single union, IG Metall, is calling on car and shipyard workers to strike amid a pay row. The German president is setting off on an Africa trip. DW has more.

image.caption: IG Metall has already called numerous strikes, as here in Sindelfingen in SeptemberImage: Marijan Murat/dpa/picture alliance
